title: Example 288 preservation through the adapter entry: 6.1.13 against 6.1.14 outside the allowed change, expected established
description: The frozen claim claims/permitted-fields-preserved.json and the task's allowed change (target.json), unchanged, run by examples/288-spring-framework-cve-2024-38820-locale-sensitive-disallowed-fields/proofs/prove.py: jvmcontract equivalence (own checker, strict gaps) of example288.adapter.LocaleDecisionAdapter#allowed(int configLocale, int bindLocale, String[] allowedPatterns, String[] disallowedPatterns, String field), the adapter compiled against each release and each release on its own four pinned JARs (--before-classpath), the claim's assumption as --assume and the allowed change as --unchanged-unless, at the claim's bound of 8. Until this change a regression check refused a String[] parameter and had no assumption. It is now made as a property of the pair of versions (lib/src/pairing.rs): one generated method calls 6.1.13, relocated under before, and then 6.1.14 on the same inputs, each array a copy of its own, and says whether they returned the same value or threw in the same category; javac compiles it against both, and the property check proves it returns true on every input of the assumption outside the allowed change. The check is given proofs/simple-match-pair.contract, the lemma for each release's own simpleMatch, 6.1.13's stated over ASCII and U+0131 (what a Turkish lower-casing leaves), each proved first by induction. Inline, at bound 4, it was established in 48 s, and with no change allowed it was refuted at bound 2 on allowed(configLocale=2, bindLocale=2, allowedPatterns={null, "I"}, disallowedPatterns={null, "i"}, field="I"), run on a JVM. Expected established for every pair of the table's five locales.
